card.title: Worth Keeping Around
card.instruction: Seek signs that your contribution still earns a place. Increase your effort whenever belonging feels uncertain.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've fixed your gate. Shall I come next Sunday and do the gutter?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Come for lunch. My brother's doing the gutter.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Lovely. I'll mend those dining chairs so there's room for me.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: There's already a chair for you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I'll check the table legs. I'd like my place here to be something you can rely on.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 repair earns another visit, A3 makes a chair to justify lunch and A5 offers reliability after the place is assured.

relationship.evidence: B2 and B4 warmly include A without conditions, making A's need visible through helpful offers.

heightening.evidence: B4 unconditional place drives A5 a new service and an explicit wish to make belonging dependable.

specificity.evidence: A1 gate and next Sunday, B2 lunch and B4 chair establish an ordinary invitation without essential hidden history.

brevityWit.evidence: A5 my place and reliable table legs connects emotional and practical meanings without a detached gag.
